## What it is

The ring, the four bars, and the cap, in place, with the tube. Not exported as its own STL.

## Design notes

- 14 openings. 46.94 mm of the 965.2 mm tube is the straight tangent from the ring's outer edge to the first opening. The helix is 918.26 mm, 3.345 turns. One turn at 43.5 mm is 274.55 mm.
- Blue 1 has four, including the lowest. Yellow 2 has four, including the highest. Green 3 has three. Orange 4 has three.
- The mouths face outward. The cap can be on. Each bar plugs straight into its own slot.
- The ring's centre hole is Ø44.8 mm. The cap's is Ø63.4 mm.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't mix these towers with the necked set. Those bores are in a different place.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. No necks. Ring and cap unchanged.
